title: U.S. House · Georgia's 2nd Congressional District
area: Southwest Georgia, including Columbus and Albany.

context.text: Incumbent Sanford Bishop Jr. (D), who has represented the district since 1993, advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary. Matt Day won the Republican primary unopposed after A. Wayne Johnson and Chuck Hand did not make the ballot. Brandon Daley is also running, on the Communist Party line.

candidates.currentRole: U.S. Representative for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District (since 1993)

summary.text: Sanford Bishop Jr. is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Georgia's 2nd Congressional District, first elected in 1992. He is a lawyer and former state legislator seeking re-election.

background.text: Born in Mobile, Alabama, in 1947; earned a bachelor's degree from Morehouse College in 1968 and a J.D. from Emory University in 1971; worked as a lawyer.
Served in the Georgia House of Representatives from 1977 to 1990 and the Georgia Senate from 1992 to 1993 before being elected to Congress.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Appropriations, including the Agriculture, Rural Development, Food and Drug Administration and Related Agencies; Financial Services and General Government; and Military Construction, Veterans Affairs and Related Agencies subcommittees, in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).
